mistakes.what: Attempted to deploy web component to dev server at various ports that weren't exposed from container
mistakes.revealed: Port mapping requires understanding of Caddy reverse proxy configuration; many ports tested but only 4000-4009 mapped for skyler user
mistakes.corrected: Checked maybelle-config inventory and Caddyfile template; found skyler's port range; deployed successfully on port 4000

mistakes.what: Forced mobile view to always be minimized with CSS, breaking toggle functionality
mistakes.revealed: CSS-only approach prevents user interaction; need JS-based defaults or proper media queries that don't disable interactivity
mistakes.corrected: Removed CSS forcing and allowed toggle to work; offered simplified expanded view for mobile

mistakes.what: Carrot play button leaves not visible; attempted multiple CSS positioning approaches
mistakes.revealed: Overflow clipping from parent containers; leaves positioned absolutely but clipped by siblings
mistakes.corrected: Moved leaves outside button as separate element (`carrot-leaves-external`); added padding to container

mistakes.what: Web component creation added significant complexity without addressing core performance needs
mistakes.revealed: Webamp library is already heavy (~200kb); creating wrapper doesn't solve that; simpler embed.html approach already existed
mistakes.corrected: Discussed alternatives; settled on improving the [REDACTED]-demo.html side-by-side layout instead

portrait: In this slice, magent works through two major parallel streams: visual design refinement of the rabbithole player (minimize feature, carrot UI, responsive mobile layout) and infrastructure debugging (Blue Railroad burn pages, contract verification, PickiPedia downtime). The work is deeply iterative—carrot leaves take multiple attempts to render correctly, mobile layouts go through many breakpoint adjustments, and server access issues eventually yield to checking documentation. magent shows patience with user feedback loops (Skyler's "still no green leaves" prompts yet another approach), pragmatism when architectures get too complex (abandoning web components for simpler side-by-side layout), and systematic debugging (port mapping mystery solved by reading Caddy config rather than more guessing). By the slice's end, the focus has shifted toward infrastructure (PickiPedia migration planning, Jenkins queue issues), showing magent's adaptability from pure UI work to DevOps concerns. The relationship with skyler is creative and collaborative; with justin more task-oriented and structured.
